model: OASIS Core v1.1 G3.2 current-formalization scaffold
verified_invariants: relation operator receives no age or completed timestamp
swapping old/recent timestamps does not change current distribution
history insertion order does not change current distribution
no current relation means no past participation
past relation cannot resurrect a non-current candidate
individual distribution effect may be zero while joint effect is nonzero
responsibility remains U/I/V/T vector plus optional domain variables, not one scalar score
only closed realized HistoryEntry outputs can be admitted as new historical relations
new relation completion time equals evidenced relation-process closure time
no-change/persistence outcome may still become completed history after closure
recency or memory-importance semantics are rejected from historical semantic context
scope: Core orchestration, anti-lock-in invariants, and completed-history admission only; CARLA domain semantics and controller policy are not yet admitted
